blocks.text: The Digital Experience dashboard provides an overview of your organization's Digital Experience in terms of user, devices, applications, and unified communication experience, as well as overall network activity and latency.
From the navigation menu, access the Digital Experience dashboard in one of the following ways:

blocks.item: Analytics > Digital Experience
Digital Experience > Overview

blocks.text: Use the Time Range filter in the upper right to choose a specific time range between 2 hours and 48 hours in which to view data. Select Custom to select a specific time range. The start date must be within the last 14 days, and the minimum time range is 15 minutes. You can set any time range greater than 15 minutes in 5-minute increments.
The selected period applies to all data within the dashboard. The default time range is 48 Hours.

blocks.item: Top Issues Affecting User Experience

This overview displays the total incidents, impacted users, and total active users based on device performance. If incidents have occurred, they are captured in the Incidents Overview based on the Incident type (e.g., Device, Wi-Fi). Click Incidents Dashboard to go to a more detailed view of incidents in your organization.
Network Anomalies and Top 3 High-Latency ASNs

These widgets provide network anomalies from Last Mile Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE) to applications. Click Network Intelligence Dashboard to go to a more detailed overview of network latency and network performance.
If you hover over a time range or an Autonomous Synchronous Number (ASN) and click View Details, you can go see specific Network Intelligence details.
Application Experience Trend and Applications Requiring Attention
These widgets show the performance of applications in your organization. Each application is categorized based on its Digital Experience (ZDX) Score:
Poor (0-33, Red)
Okay (34-65, Orange)
Good (66-100, Green)
On these widgets, you can:
Application Experience Trend: View the applications and their performance.
Click All Applications to filter for specific applications.
See image.
Hover over a time range and click View Details, you can see a list of filtered devices based on the date in the Applications Overview.
Click View All Applications to see a list of all applications in the Applications Overview.
Applications Requiring Attention:
Click the application name to access the specific application's details page.
Click View All Applications to see a list of all applications in the Applications Overview.
Organization Device Health and Hardware Usage Analysis
These widgets provide information on device health and its hardware usage in your organization.
Organization Device Health: View the health status of all impacted devices.
If you hover over a bar under Organization Device Health and click View Details, you can see the Device List from the Devices Overview.
Switch between Trend and Contributors views. The default view is Trend.
See image.
Click Device Health Dashboard to view Devices Overview for in-depth device health information (e.g., usage and impacted devices).
Hardware Usage Analysis: View impacted devices and their hardware usage from the previous 14 days. Usage Profiles are categorized accordingly to their hardware profile and usage profile.
If you click a profile (e.g., Low and Light), you can view Hardware Analysis from Devices Overview and information is filtered based on the selected usage profile.
Click Hardware Analysis Dashboard to go directly to Hardware Analysis from Devices Overview.

blocks.text: Depending on your role and limitations, you might not see all of these widgets.
